newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Standard plans rand LME settlement prices.
newsitem.headline: Standard plans rand LME settlement prices.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank said on Monday it would provide rand-denominated settlement prices for all base metals traded on the London Metal Exchange (LME) from next month.

"Standard Bank London has...decided to operate a daily settlement price in rand for all LME metals," Paul Shuman, marketing manager for the bank's base metals division in London, told a Metal Bulletin conference here.

The introduction of the Standard Bank Rand Metals Fix -- based around the end-morning London metal dollar rate -- will help South African players hedge their risk and should boost involvement on the LME, Shuman said.
"Customers will be able to place orders with us to buy or sell at the rand fix and will be guaranteed execution at that price," he said.
"This will allow our customers to more safely hedge their metal exposures in rand."
Shuman said the new facility would bring new customers to the LME as the move from sterling to U.S. dollar settlement had done a few years ago.
